topic: 限时写作：图表概述与关键比较
grammarFocus: 趋势、比较、比例、时态与数据句的准确性。
title: Timed Academic Writing: Urban Cycling and Congestion
prompt: In many large cities, the number of people commuting by bicycle has risen sharply over the past decade, yet traffic congestion and road accidents involving cyclists remain serious problems. Some people argue that the best solution is to invest heavily in separate cycle lanes and safer road design, while others believe that stricter rules for all road users and better public transport are more effective. Discuss both these views and give your own opinion on which approach is more likely to reduce congestion and improve road safety. Write at least 250 words.
instructions: 本题为限时写作练习（建议40分钟）。请先花约5分钟审题并列出双方观点及你自己的立场，再用约30分钟完成至少250词的完整议论文，最后留5分钟检查。写作时须做到：清楚呈现“修建独立自行车道与改善道路设计”和“严格交通规则与提升公共交通”两种观点，分别说明其理由与可能局限；明确给出你自己的立场，并解释为何该立场更能同时缓解拥堵与提升安全。注意使用比较与让步结构（while, whereas, although, nevertheless）以及清晰的段落主题句。所有场景与数据均为模拟练习材料，并非官方雅思试卷，也不代表任何真实城市统计。
